## Key Production Projects
- [Zewar Desk — Multi-Tenant Jewellery ERP](https://github.com/rajakrp18): Multi-tenant ERP platform across 4 business domains (inventory, billing, customer CRM, automated reporting) with 18+ modular REST APIs, JWT HTTP-only cookies, RBAC authorization, and Playwright E2E testing.
- [Cyber Law Watch Agent (LexSentry)](https://github.com/rajakrp18/cyberlaw-watchdog): Autonomous regulatory & judicial intelligence platform ingesting and priority-scoring (P0-P2) rulings across 8 judicial/regulatory bodies (Supreme Court, High Courts, RBI, CERT-In) with Gemini Legal RAG Copilot, certified PDF citations, and local statutory ratio fallback.
- [Contact Finder & Project Researcher Monorepo](https://project-researcher-contact-finder.vercel.app): Enterprise AI monorepo combining an Indian OSINT contact-attribution engine (4-agent pipeline: Coordinator, Researcher, Extractor, Verifier with 0-100% confidence scoring) and an automated PRD/architecture generator. Repository: https://github.com/rajakrp18/Project-Researcher
